category: Configure Compilation, Interpreter, and Build Processes to Improve Executable Security (PW)
subcategory_text: Apply security-relevant compiler and interpreter flags, language modes, and runtime options that reduce the attack surface of the executable.
implementation_examples: Compile with -O2 or higher to enable most hardening checks
Enable PIE, full RELRO, BIND_NOW on Linux ELF builds
Use signed modules and script execution policies where supported
assessment_objectives: Determine whether security-relevant compile/runtime options are applied consistently.
Determine whether option changes are tracked in build manifests.
